title: Aggregate local Playwright verification after Worklet CSP coverage update

source.head: 76812fb26211a779ca93279ec49b7df2d5d02243
source.sourceNote: Run exercised the current working tree on top of HEAD, including the Worklet CSP regression; this evidence does not certify the HEAD commit alone.

coverageNotes: The configured run includes the 324-resource responsive browser matrix, Gold accessibility and variant checks, route and Compose/Workbench flows, CSP and preview-isolation probes, and configured constrained-network and large-Workbench workloads.
The Worklet module-loading regression passed in the Sites Worker CSP suite on desktop and mobile; browser CSP rejected the addModule request and no external response succeeded.
Configured skips remain skips and are not treated as passes.
Playwright timing checks are local browser benchmarks; trace-based Core Web Vitals were not run because Chrome DevTools setup is pending.
No production Site was deployed or modified by this run.
materialToolWarnings: Node reported that NO_COLOR is ignored when FORCE_COLOR is set. No test failed because of this warning.
